purpose: Teach: 各人/個々人/同国/番手/会期/座談/顔面/おこなう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、各人の役割を見極められた
lines.en: Father — at the founding, he had the gift of seeing each person's true role.
lines.style: Quiet, unhurried. Gentle weight on each phrase. Speaking from deep memory. Patient pause between thoughts, like turning pages in a long book.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは個々人を尊重された
lines.en: Yes. Father had profound respect for each individual person.
lines.style: Steady, measured. A solemn nod in the voice. Not lecturing — affirming what was seen. Quiet conviction that this was the right way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、同国の取引先と長くお付き合いされた
lines.en: Father — he maintained long partnerships with business associates across the region.
lines.style: Soft, almost musing. A slight lift on the memory itself, then settling. Speaking as if seeing it happen again. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界番手を意識して経営された
lines.en: Yes. Father managed with constant awareness of the industry landscape.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Each word placed carefully. The tone of someone learning what leadership truly meant by watching it practiced. Steady eye-contact tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、国会の会期に合わせて陳情に行かれた
lines.en: Father — he would make petitions to parliament, timing them to the session calendar.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Speaking of something rare and deliberate. The precision of it — the care taken — comes through softly. Trailing off into memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは座談会で社員と対話された
lines.en: Yes. Father held roundtable meetings with his staff — he dialogued with them himself.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Not boastful — stating fact with quiet pride. The directness of his presence. Steady, grounded tone. A small pause before the close, like settling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の顔面の疲れにも気付かれた
lines.en: Father — he could read exhaustion in his staff's faces. He noticed.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender. The weight of that attention. Speaking of something that mattered. Slight breathiness — the intimacy of being truly seen. Gentle fadeout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員研修を自らおこなう熱意だった
lines.en: Yes. Father conducted staff training himself — that was the depth of his passion.
lines.style: Firm with warmth. A quiet culmination. The voice carries both the memory and its weight. Not lecturing — bearing witness. Settled, final, honoring.
